author: javh_u2
quote: A 10/10 Masterpiece — The Greatest Game of All Time, Perfected.There are no words to truly capture how incredible this remake is. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was already the greatest video game ever made, and this Nintendo Switch 2 version elevates it to absolute perfection. Every single frame looks like a living painting, the re-orchestrated soundtrack gives you chills from start to finish, and the modernized controls make exploring Hyrule feel effortless and magical. From the expanded Castle Town to the voiced cutscenes, every addition respects the soul of the original while making it feel brand new. An absolute must-play and an easy 10/10.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: javh_u2
quote: Honestly, I don’t understand the high scores from the media. This game is a prime example of bought reviews and pure hype. From the moment you start playing, it’s plagued with game-breaking bugs, terrible optimization, and clunky mechanics. It feels like an unfinished beta sold at full price. Don’t trust the 9/10 and 10/10 ratings from major outlets—this game is massively overrated and definitely not worth your money right now.
